msg: Hello, we're two Open Water divers from Australia coming on a cruise ship. We dock in Cartagena at 7:00 am and must be back on board by 6:00 pm the same day. Can we do a dive trip with you that day?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, the timing can work for the Cartagena two-dive trip: departure is at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita, and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., arriving around 4:15 p.m.—before your 6:00 p.m. boarding deadline.

Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers).

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. Is there any risk we miss the ship if the boat is late? We're Australian citizens, no Colombian ID. Please send me the link for two people.
reply:
The return to Cartagena is scheduled for 3:00 p.m., with an estimated arrival around 4:15 p.m. That leaves about 1 hour 45 minutes before your 6:00 p.m. boarding deadline, but I can’t guarantee there will be no delay. The boat schedule is fixed, and if you need an adjustment, a team advisor would need to review it.

As Australian citizens, you’ll pay in USD. The online price is *$178 per person* for the two-dive trip, with the 10% online discount applied automatically. The booking link is: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en

Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers).

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

For the one who hasn't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Certified diving* — Guided dives for already-certified divers; explore the reef at depth.
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.
